by_day.latin: Saturnus per diem in horoscopo partiliter constitutus, id est si in ea parte est qua horoscopus, faciet cum summo clamore edi partum. Erit autem iste, qui nascitur, maior omnibus fratribus, aut, si quis ante eum natus fuerit, a parentibus separatur. Semper autem deus iste per diem in omnibus quattuor car- dinibus faciet primos nasci aut primos nutriri aut eos fratres, qui ante se nati fuerint, facit inflatos ac superbiae spiritu sublevatos.

judgment.latin: DEIECTIS LOCIS. Residua quattuor loca pigra et deiecta esse dicuntur ob hoc, quod nulla cum horoscopo societate iunguntur. Est autem ex his residuis quattuor locis primus, qui in secundo ab horoscopo signo constituitur, qui locus inferna porta dicitur vel anafora; in diametro huius signi locus qui fuerit id est in VIII. ab horoscopo signo, epicatafora appellatur. Novissima vero sunt Malae fortunae et Mali daemonis-, et Mala fortuna in VI. ab horoscopo <(signo> constituitur, Malus vero daemon in XII. ab horoscopo signo ponitur, sed Malam fortunam Graeci cacen tychen appellant, Malum daemonem id est [in] XII. ab horoscopo signum cacodaemonem Graeci vocant.
judgment.engine_rendering: The remaining four places are called idle and cast down, because they are joined to the ascendant by no society. The last are Bad Fortune and Bad Daimon: Bad Fortune is set in the 6th sign from the ascendant, Bad Daimon in the 12th; the Greeks call Bad Fortune kake tyche and Bad Daimon kakodaimon.

saturn_jupiter.square.engine_rendering: If Jupiter and Saturn are joined by square radiation and Saturn is the superior, holding the right-side square from above while Jupiter, made inferior, is seen in the left square: they decree crises of life, diminish the substance of the patrimony, turn all their counsels awry, impede their actions, disturb their minds with various dissensions of spirit, assail the fathers with various kinds of calamity, and scatter the paternal substance too in various lacerations.

saturn_jupiter.opposition.latin: Saturnus et luppiter si diametra se radiatione respexerint, et iu contrariis constituti locis longa se invicem virium suarum potestate pulsaverint, in omnibus actibus ista coniunctio multa infortuniorum decernit exitia,
saturn_jupiter.opposition.engine_rendering: If Saturn and Jupiter behold one another by diameter, and, standing in contrary places, strike one another from afar with the power of their strengths, that conjunction decrees in all actions many ruinous misfortunes,
restricted_clauses: the continuation 'ex casu filiorum acerba doloris tormenta' (torments of grief from the fall of children) is encoded only as this note and never rendered

saturn_jupiter.conjunction.latin: Si Saturnus et luppiter unum hospitium partis acceperint, et in uno loco pariter constituti aequabili societatis potestate iungantur, si in opportunis geniturae locis et in his in quibus gaudent signis vel partibus ista fuerint radiatione societatis coniuncti, felicitatis insignia, patrimonii augmenta, gloriae commodaj virtutis incorrupta praesidia, felicem sobolem filiorum ex ista societate decernunt, praesertim si fuerit diurna genitura.
saturn_jupiter.conjunction.engine_rendering: If Saturn and Jupiter have received the lodging of one degree, and set together in one place are joined in an equal partnership of power - if they are joined in that partnership in the fitting places of the nativity and in the signs or degrees in which they rejoice - they decree the insignia of felicity, increase of patrimony, the advantages of glory, the uncorrupted protections of virtue, and a happy offspring of children, especially if the nativity is diurnal.

conditional_extensions.effect: the verdict is strengthened - both are of the diurnal sect
the whole verdict is overturned by Mars' envious radiation (VI.22.3)

jupiter_venus.trine.latin: Si luppiter et Venus fuerint trigonica radiatione coniuncti, et sint ambo in oportunis geniturae locis positi, et ab omnibus deiectionum bumilitatibus separati, maximam decernunt gratiam venustatis, et omnibus bonis amabili iUos conversatione semper adsociant, et fidum amorem circa illos uxorum semper indicunt. Sed augmenta patrimonii et dignitatis insignia aut amicorum illis aut uxorum praesidio conferuntur.
jupiter_venus.trine.engine_rendering: If Jupiter and Venus are joined by trine radiation, and both are set in the fitting places of the nativity and separated from all the humiliations of dejection, they decree the greatest grace of charm, ally the natives to all good men in amiable intercourse, and always announce the faithful love of wives around them; and increases of patrimony and the insignia of dignity are conferred on them by the protection of friends or of wives.

jupiter_mercury.trine.latin: et Mercurius fuerint trigonica radiatione coniuncti, et sint ambo in oportunis geniturae locis positi, et ab omnibus deiectionum bumilitatibus separati, facient ingeniosos cordatos acerrima ingenii potestate firmatos, et qui omnia negotia prosperis semper actibus exequantur.
jupiter_mercury.trine.engine_rendering: If Jupiter and Mercury are joined by trine radiation, and both are set in the fitting places of the nativity and separated from all the humiliations of dejection, they will make men ingenious, sensible, grounded in the keenest power of intellect, who carry out all their business with ever-prosperous actions.

exceptions: Kroll/Skutsch/Ziegler's apparatus prints the Greek parallels from the Anonymous De planetis (CCAG II) beneath these chapters and records Heeg's finding that both descend from Dorotheus; the delineations are therefore lineage-bearing, not Firmicus' inventions.
